ends.note: west end at the Mill Creek bank

notes: Mostly open ground: the B&O S.W. R.R. tracks cross at x 1200-1700 and the strip west of x 1050 is marked SEE VOLUME FIVE. Alfred (printed ALFRED, 30') runs from Mill Creek east across Garrard to Valley; Queen City Av crosses Mill Creek on a bridge at the left edge (no intersection there). Valley (printed VALLEY, 60') lies in the binding gutter: west curb at x 6315, a R.R. track at about x 6400 and the east curb just past the fold, so the two Valley points are estimated and x is compressed there; treat them as less precise. Garrard continues north of Alfred and south of Queen City.
